description: Paged results. Pass `cursor` back to continue. Cursors are session-scoped and expire after 10 minutes. Paged methods take `limit` + `cursor` and return `items` + `cursor` + `total`.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous page (session-scoped, expires after 10 minutes).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null when this is the last page.

total.description: Total count when known cheaply; null otherwise.
